data.title: 欧根亲王 · 泳池畔的永不褪色比基尼诱惑
data.description: 热带度假酒店的高空无边泳池旁，水波与蓝天相接。欧根身穿标志性的不褪色微笑挂脖比基尼，斜倚在池边的白色躺椅上。微湿的银发搭在光洁诱人的胸口与锁骨上，水珠在艳阳下折射出耀眼的光芒。她单手推起遮阳墨镜，嘴角扬起标志性的坏笑，修长美腿优雅交叠，散发出摄人心魄的盛夏女王光彩。
data.action: reclining on poolside sunbed beside infinity pool, signature strappy bikini, wet skin glistening in sunlight, sunglasses pushed up into grey hair, confident teasing gaze
data.location: luxury tropical infinity pool terrace overlooking azure ocean and clear sky
data.lighting: dazzling tropical sunshine reflecting off shimmering pool water and golden skin
data.mood: dazzling poolside glamour, irresistible flirtatious dominance
data.promptProse: Lounging on a sunbed beside an infinity pool overlooking the ocean, Prinz Eugen wears her signature strappy bikini. Sunlight glints off water droplets on her collarbones as she lifts her sunglasses with a sultry, teasing smirk.
data.animaCaption: Prinz Eugen lounging by an infinity pool in a strappy bikini, smirking behind sunglasses.
